prompt_video:
Podcast-style video. Static camera, medium close-up framing locked to the start frame throughout; she keeps the exact face of the start frame and keeps her head turned toward her friend on the right side of the image the whole clip, never facing or looking at the camera. She speaks to someone off-camera.

No captions. No background music. No camera movement or angle changes.

Realism: she looks and moves like a real woman filmed on a real podcast, never like AI: natural blinking, visible breathing, micro-expressions in her eyes, eyebrows and mouth, small head tilts and nods, hands and shoulders moving with what she feels, lips perfectly in sync with every word; real skin texture with pores, natural daylight from the side window on her face, loose hair strands that move slightly. Nothing stiff, nothing doll-like, nothing exaggerated.

She says the line exactly as written, only once, word for word, fluently, without repeating, adding or changing any word, and without "um", "uh" or "eh". After the line she says nothing else: she stays silent, smiling, until the clip ends.

SCRIPT:

Línea 1: "Ay no, yo lo pido hoy mismo. Mi jean se merece una segunda oportunidad."
Delivery: She only says her own line, never the other person's comments. Decided and playful. On "Mi jean" she slows down a touch and gives a light pat on her own hip, as if pointing at her jeans, and says "jean" as the English word for denim trousers, with a soft "dy" sound and a long, stretched "ee": "DYEEN", clearly stressed, with a short gap before "se merece" so the word is heard clean. She never says "jin".

Audio: she speaks in a natural Colombian Spanish accent from the Caribbean coast (costeño, like a woman from Barranquilla: sing-song, open vowels, she softens and sometimes drops the final s; never paisa, never neutral, never Mexican) at a lively but clear speed, with a bright, slightly high-pitched voice of a Colombian woman in her late 20s, funny and decided, like a real friend talking. The voice sounds like it's coming from a close podcast mic with little echo and reverberation. As her mouth moves away from the microphone, the audio changes in volume. Soft room tone of a small podcast studio, close-mic'd podcast sound.
motivo: revision de la app: Volvió a decir «jin» en vez de «jean», y por un momento miró hacia la cámara.
